about.A: absorbance, -log10 of a reflectance ratio; bigger means darker.  0.001 A is about 0.23 % of the light.
about.R: a photo's reflectance at a pixel: the signal divided by the gray-chip level at that pixel (shading_review.frame).
about.interior: pad pixels 8 or more layer pixels from every edge
about.dye_A: rough dye level: -log10 of the first post-image's interior median R over that of the undyed strip C1039 (holder F).  Two strips, so good to about 0.01 A.  A.
about.what: Change in the stain from one capture to the next, by sample and channel.  drift_study.drift_repeats().
about.files: the repeat post-images, in capture order
about.dA: per repeat n: interior median of -log10(R_n / R_0), the first post-image lined up onto repeat n.  A, darker +.
about.per_capture_A: least-squares slope of dA against n: change per capture, A.
